entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EFCore 10 RC1 - Issue with the generated parameter names #36918
  • Regression in EF Core 10: SQL Parameter Name Collision on SQL Server due to Case-Insensitive Variable Names #36917
    10.0.0

Closed

  • DbCommand cancellation when using enumerables #36919
  • Internal `PRAGMA foreign_check = 0;` commands for SQLite migrations are triggering `NonTransactionalMigrationOperationWarning` #35871
    11.0.0
  • "ef dbcontext optimize --nativeaot" generates uncompilable code for arrays of enums #35767
  • EntityFrameworkCore.Cosmos with inheritance hierarchy: how can I perform point reads when querying a derived class by ID and partition key? #36882
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Merged

  • Use `PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys` instead of `PRAGMA foreign_keys` when migrating #35873
    community-contribution
  • Correct Cosmos ReadItem logic for abstract base types #36884
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36912
  • Apply file-scoped namespace to CosmosTransactionalBatchWrapper #36914
